blindComparison: No blind comparison or browser run was performed by this reviewer. This is an independent check of the instrument's source wiring and Node counterexamples, not a quality judgment against a reference work.

manualSave.scope: Actual Director.update/save and extracted saveOnExit callback; world-update collaborators are Node doubles, no browser event was dispatched.

visibility.scope: Predicate counterexamples in Node. No claim about the actual rendered browser surface.

browserScope.chromium: Real chromium rendering and trusted single-touch actions; seeded legacy fixture and in-memory manual-save witness. No physical-phone or full-playthrough claim.
browserScope.webkit: Real webkit rendering and trusted single-touch actions; seeded legacy fixture and in-memory manual-save witness. No physical-phone or full-playthrough claim.

visibility_after.scope: The unmodified visibleBox function executed against Node rectangle/style doubles, not a browser measurement.

next_action: Run commit 80dd49044496d5a1434a81efcc615bbbfcb0c0fd's corrected helper in the authorized WebKit CI environment; inspect the actual report and screenshots. Node predicate checks are not a substitute for that execution.

resolved_findings.problem: Snapshotting original main bytes before reload can disagree with the legitimate pagehide save.
resolved_findings.resolution: Root moved the snapshot after reload and ready. Actual exit-save callback updated bytes; old preservation predicate returned false and revised predicate true.

resolved_findings.problem: An automatic v2 save after Continue can satisfy the final manual SAVE check even if the SAVE action is inert.
resolved_findings.resolution: Root added a clearly labelled in-memory witness absent from storage before tapping SAVE. Actual Director.update made the old predicate true without manual SAVE; the revised predicate stayed false until actual save.

resolved_findings.fix: Check the intended visible/announced condition honestly. For a visual claim, measure the status against viewport and clipping ancestors plus effective style; for a text/ARIA-only claim, name only that measured scope. Counterexample acceptance must be 0.
resolved_findings.hypothesis: The predicate checks text presence and never measures effective visibility or clipping.
resolved_findings.problem: The instrument reports a visibly announced restoration using textContent alone. Its actual extraction/check accepts a status element with display:none, visibility:hidden, opacity:0, zero height and an offscreen position.
resolved_findings.resolution: The helper now uses its actual visibleBox function. All 13 control/adversarial rectangle/style cases behave as expected, including the old offscreen/hidden counterexamples and ancestor clipping.
resolved_findings.shot: tools/mobile_save_recovery.mjs: recovered announcement and visibly-announced check
resolved_findings.why: A passing check would claim a visual result that the instrument did not observe. The status precedes all copies, while restoring the last copy scrolls toward the bottom.

resolved_findings.fix: After the chosen scroll action, measure vertical bounds and effective clipping/visibility as well as width/height/x. All three saved geometry counterexamples must be rejected without replacing genuine browser measurement with Node results.
resolved_findings.hypothesis: The lower-size floor and x bounds omit y, bottom and clipping constraints.
resolved_findings.problem: The recovery button 'fit the mobile viewport' predicate checks horizontal bounds only. It accepts rectangles wholly above or below 667x375 and one with height 1000.
resolved_findings.resolution: The helper now uses its actual visibleBox function. All 13 control/adversarial rectangle/style cases behave as expected, including the old offscreen/hidden counterexamples and ancestor clipping.
resolved_findings.why: The gate can pass a control whose touchable area is clipped or outside the mobile viewport.

resolved_findings.evidence: tools/test-iphone-webkit.mjs BROWSER_NAME and newContext selection; helper scope literal
resolved_findings.fix: Use the measured caller browser value in the scope or refuse unsupported engines; a Chromium-labelled caller must never produce a WebKit claim.
resolved_findings.hypothesis: The helper assumes the default browser rather than using report.browser.
resolved_findings.problem: The helper's scope always says Real WebKit, although the caller explicitly supports CINDERLINE_BROWSER=chromium.
resolved_findings.resolution: The helper now interpolates report.browser; the actual scope expression produces webkit and chromium accurately.
resolved_findings.why: A Chromium surrogate run would carry a contradictory engine claim inside the recovery evidence.

scope.methods: Read actual source; invoke actual Storage, Director.update/save, and extracted saveOnExit callback with memory storage and world collaborators doubled; evaluate instrument predicates using adversarial values.

source_wiring_checks.copy_structure: The actual menu reverses the three seeded copies: unreadable first, future second, readable legacy last. Current shape yields three export buttons and one restore button.
source_wiring_checks.fixture_scope: The old fixture is read from tools/fixtures/save-v1.json payload; both versions are raised for the future sample. The helper explicitly says seeding is setup rather than gameplay achievement.
source_wiring_checks.geometry_probe_connection: The newly added submittedGeometry probe is restored in a finally block before exerciseSaveRecovery; its frames-only result does not replace recovery measurements.
source_wiring_checks.import_and_invocation: exerciseSaveRecovery is imported and awaited after the soak; shared check() appends failures, and exceptions reach the caller's failed report.
source_wiring_checks.locale_selector_hypothesis_refuted: Japanese ui.set.language.row is deliberately 'Language'; export and restore labels match ファイルに保存 and このコピーを使う.
source_wiring_checks.notification_observation: The notice box is checked immediately after the restore tap without a compensating scroll; restoration-result.png is then captured. A currently offscreen notice is expected to fail honestly.
source_wiring_checks.output_and_errors: Output directory and report.screenshots/interaction exist before invocation; final page/console/request/HTTP checks run after the helper returns.
source_wiring_checks.remaining_control_assumption: The instrument now asserts actual MODE.MENU before adding the manual-save witness.

validation.syntax: node --check passed for both final instrument files; exerciseSaveRecovery imports as a function without invoking a browser.

verdict_scope: The requested source/Node instrument review has no unresolved findings. This does not mark the added WebKit checks or any product element passed.
